rack_series: EMA_EPMR_PRG_NUS_DPG monthly US regular gasoline rack sales price by refiners, excluding taxes
rack_candidate: production minus 0.5 times year-over-year change in (quarterly national monthly rack average minus existing regional weekly spot average)
rack_weight: Fixed 0.5 before scoring; no fitting or optimization; broad national-v-regional diagnostic, not observed company rack costs
rack_coverage: Require all three current and all three prior-year months; no extrapolation after March 2022; no monthly release-date assumption
rack_periods: Same-quarter full-period explanatory test using today's archive; historical publication vintages not verified and lagged monthly values may have been unavailable at quarter-end
regimes: Earlier pre2020, transition2020 and modern2021+ reported separately
regional_context: Rerun frozen regional stocks/utilization and lagged revenue-gap experiments without changing specifications; summarize previously frozen all-grade/diesel and daily-price coverage separately
disclosures: Reproduce all archived mechanical scoring links and arithmetic; preserve observed versus modelled gallon distinction; no new source completeness claim
pump_panel: Run existing manual-only readiness validation; no fabricated station prices or permission bypass
commercial_rack: No purchase, free trial enrollment or licensing commitment authorized; continuous local series remains blocked
promotion: None automatic; even a positive tiny historical rack result would not establish live predictive utility
